item.title: My Swedish Career: 'I started a networking group I wish had existed when I came here’
item.description: Elizabeth Wright Veintimilla moved to Sweden almost five years ago after her now-husband was offered a job. After constantly putting herself out there to land a job in the non-profit sector, she had an idea: why not introduce the people she’d been networking with to each other?

item.title: Swedish word of the day: strunta
item.description: Today's Swedish word is one that comes in handy when you just can't be bothered any more.

item.title: EXPLAINED: How to survive Sweden's bizarre home tour ritual
item.description: When visiting a new friend in Sweden, be prepared to be given a bewilderingly thorough tour of every room in the house – sometimes even down to the walk-in wardrobe. This is the 'husesyn' ritual.

item.title: INTERVIEW: ‘Sweden stands fully behind Denmark and Greenland’
item.description: Sweden views US claims to Greenland as ‘very problematic’, but Nato’s newest member still sees the United States as a vital partner for European defence and security, Sweden’s Minister for EU Affairs Jessica Rosencrantz tells The Local.

item.title: Healthcare: What you need to know when moving to Sweden with children
item.description: Sweden is often cited as one of the best countries in the world for raising children, but what do international parents need to know when planning a move here? And can your children access healthcare without a Swedish personal number?

item.title: How to sell your house or apartment in Sweden – six key points
item.description: If you want to sell your house or apartment it's a good idea to prepare well in advance, but you may not always have that option. These are six things you should be considering if you need or want to make a sale.

item.title: Why did Sweden greenlight so few new citizenships in 2025?
item.description: In this week's podcast: new citizenship and work permit stats, Swedish words for wintry weather, Swedish foods with official EU protections, and how to enrol your child in a Swedish school.

item.title: Inside Sweden: Prospective citizens' passports are held hostage by long waiting times
item.description: The Local's Deputy Editor Becky Waterton rounds up the biggest stories of the week in our Inside Sweden newsletter.

item.title: EU to ink long-awaited trade deal with South American bloc
item.description: The European Union will on Saturday sign a deal 25 years in the making with the South American trade bloc Mercosur, creating one of the world's largest free trade areas at a time of growing protectionism and volatility.

item.title: Why are young Europeans increasingly supporting anti-immigration parties?
item.description: Younger voters across Europe are increasingly tempted by hard-right and anti-migrant parties, but experts say this can't be explained by anti-immigration politics alone.
